 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Casper Ruud and Carlos Alcaraz will meet in the semi-finals of the 2026 Paris Masters on Saturday, November 7, with a place in the final at stake.
 Alcaraz booked his spot in the last four after a dramatic comeback against Taylor Fritz, overcoming the American 6-7, 7-5, 6-3. Ruud, meanwhile, defeated lucky loser Nuno Borges 7-6, 6-4 to reach the semi-finals.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The semi-final will be their eighth meeting on tour, with Alcaraz holding a dominant 6-1 advantage in the head-to-head record. Their most recent meeting came at Indian Wells in March 2026, where Alcaraz won 6-1, 7-6(2).
 Ruud's only ATP Tour victory over Alcaraz came at the 2024 ATP Finals, when he defeated the Spaniard 6-1, 7-5. Alcaraz has won their last two encounters, including their Tokyo semi-final in 2025 and their Indian Wells meeting earlier this year.
 Carlos Alcaraz reacts against USA's Ben Shelton during the men's singles quarter-final tennis match on day ten of the US Open tennis tournament at the USTA Billie Jean King National Tennis Center in New York City on September 9, 2026. (Photo by Leonardo MUNOZ / AFP via Getty Images)Leonardo MUNOZ / AFP via Getty Images
 The rivalry between the two has also already produced some major tennis moments, including the 2022 Miami Open final and the 2022 US Open final, which were both won by Alcaraz.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement What Time Does Casper Ruud vs. Carlos Alcaraz Start?
 The semi-final is scheduled for Saturday, November 7, on Centre Court at the Paris Masters. It is the second singles semi-final and is not scheduled to begin before 5:00 p.m. local time in Paris , meaning the actual start could be later depending on the preceding match.
 USA: 12:00 p.m. ET / 9:00 a.m. PT
 Norway: 5:00 p.m. CET
 Spain: 5:00 p.m. CET
 UK: 4:00 p.m. GMT
 Canada: 12:00 p.m. ET / 9:00 a.m. PT
 Europe: 5:00 p.m. CET (Central European Time; varies by time zone) 
 India: 9:30 p.m. IST
 Australia: 3:00 a.m. AEDT on Sunday, November 8 (Sydney/Melbourne) 
 How To Watch Casper Ruud vs. Carlos Alcaraz?
 USA: Tennis Channel and Tennis Channel Plus; streaming is also available through Fubo.
 Norway: TV 2 Norway and TV 2 Play.
 Spain: Movistar Plus+ on TV, with streaming available through Movistar Plus+ and Tennis TV.
 UK: Sky Sports Tennis and Sky UK; streaming is available through NOW and Sky Go.
 Canada: TSN and RDS; streaming is available through their respective digital services.
 Europe: Coverage varies by country. Tennis TV is available in many European markets, while countries with local rights use their designated broadcasters.
 India: Sony Sports, with streaming available through Sony LIV and FanCode.
 Australia: beIN Sports Australia, Stan Sport and Nine Network.
